subject.title: eBay ES: 86k own listings live in snapshot without stocks_marketplace row

question: Should the marketplace/data team run the eBay ES backfill now for only the `Happ-*` orphan listings with `quantity > 0`, and defer `quantity=0/null` rows to a separate cleanup decision?
rationale: The fix is a mass data mutation touching far more than 10 rows, so repository policy requires a dry-run, exact count, samples, literal filter, and explicit human approval before execution.

options.title: Backfill sellable orphan rows first
options.body: Run the dry-run/backfill for the 1,731 positive-quantity own orphan listings, then reconcile withdrawals and track the zero-quantity population separately.

options.title: Broaden the backfill scope
options.body: Include `quantity=0/null` orphan listings in the same operation, accepting a larger review and rollback surface before execution.

options.title: Pause for more investigation
options.body: Leave the issue open while marketplace/data validates whether the remote zero-quantity population needs any local representation.

recommendation.title: Backfill sellable orphan rows first
recommendation.body: Run the dry-run/backfill for the 1,731 positive-quantity own orphan listings, then reconcile withdrawals and track the zero-quantity population separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the eBay ES report path and the posted evidence for this issue.
